notes.title: Swordia Major Update
notes.notes:
A MAJOR content patch has been pushed to Swordia. Due to the amount of bugs in the initial alpha state... I unfortunately had to wipe progress in the database. Here is a list of new features and changes:

New areas to explore along with new monsters and other interactable content.
Diagonal movement systems
Lag fixes (The game stutters no more!)
Fishing has been added, though many new fishing improvements are underway
Lots of rebalancing of existing content
Lots of patches to exploits that previously existed
And so much more!

The price of Swordia has been updated from $4.99 to $9.99 as we near closer to full release.
